## Reading guidance

- Treat the profile as a public self-description, not a complete or permanent definition of the person.
- Distinguish verifiable facts, current opinions, and open research questions.
- Do not infer a complete worldview from a list of interests.
- For project status or specific claims, follow the linked primary documents and current repository records.
- The profile was last updated on 2026-11-27; project status may change independently.
